testcase.name: sheet callbacks retire on email change and removal and refresh within one email
disposed input cannot edit or submit and a fresh editor still works
entered count reflects rendered capacity instead of excess caller text
one visible named editor grows to the input minimum
excess controlled value is not silently submitted as a truncated code
decorative digits do not create duplicate text stops
native connection supports replacement middle edits deletion and leading zeros
old editor action reads latest code callback and enabled state
Hindi editor has a localized persistent name
sheet renders and announces the exact retry error while retaining code
ASCII filtering matches the live KYC contract and preserves leading zero
exact optional error is attached to the visible editor
sending sheet does not claim the code has already been sent
native back cannot hide a verifying sheet and dismisses once ready
